title: Career Services
intro: Career Services offers information and assistance to aid military Service Members, retirees, Veterans, DoD Civilian employees, and their family members in their career planning and job search endeavors.

sections.markdown:
The Career Centers offer comprehensive information and resource services at two on-base locations:

- Marine & Family Programs – BLDG 13150
- Leatherneck Lanes – BLDG 1339

Services include:

- Resource Libraries
- Job Announcements
- Job Search Assistance
- Computers, Internet
- Printers
- Copiers
- Special Employer Events

sections.heading: Workshops/Classes
sections.markdown:
**Optional Seminars**

Personal and Professional Development (PPD) provides optional seminars for active duty service members and their spouses.

_PPD California Military Benefits Brief sponsored by California Transition Assistance Program (CalTAP)_ for transitioning service members staying in California.

Free half-day seminar, geared toward those who have an interest/intention in residing in California after separating. The focus of this seminar is to connect service members and their families with California-specific resources to ensure success in civilian life. Topics include veteran benefits, education, employment, and entrepreneurship. Taught by subject matter experts who are ready to answer questions.
